description.short: Learn trading through lessons, drills, and simulated practice — not buy/sell signals.
description.full:
TradeAcademy by Aithera helps you learn trading through education and simulated practice.

The loop is Learn → Practice → Replay → Simulate → Journal → Review → Improve. Academy lessons teach concepts with charts and exercises. Practice drills train judgment. Paper simulation uses labelled simulated capital (default $100,000 USD) — not a brokerage and not real money. Journal and Review grade reasoning, risk, and plan adherence. Simulated profit does not mean you made a good decision.

Anyone may download and explore Guest mode. Creating an account or purchasing a subscription requires being at least 18 (or the age of majority where required). A 4+ App Store rating is content suitability only — it does not mean a minor may legally trade.

TradeAcademy is not a broker, does not execute trades, does not handle real money, and does not provide buy/sell signals, guaranteed returns, or investment advice. Scores such as DQS measure process quality, never price direction.

Premium unlocks deeper Academy, Replay, Trading DNA, and review tools. Free remains a complete way to learn, practise, simulate, and journal. Monthly (`tradeacademy_premium_monthly`) and yearly (`tradeacademy_premium_yearly`) subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled in App Store subscription settings. Lifetime (`tradeacademy_premium_lifetime`), if shown on the purchase sheet, is a one-time purchase and does not auto-renew. Cancellation stops renewal while access continues through the store-reported paid-through date. The yearly plan includes a 7-day trial only when shown on the App Store purchase sheet.
